taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-20, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 64.6 | 2.65 | 2.65
2 | 775.4 | 0.67 | 3.32
3 | 110.3 | 1.09 | 4.41
4 | 222.5 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as A-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-20, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-20 (Survey Area T)**

**Layer Sequence:**
* **Layer 1** (0–2.65 m): 64.6 Ω·m
* **Layer 2** (2.65–3.32 m): 775.4 Ω·m
* **Layer 3** (3.32–4.41 m): 110.3 Ω·m
* **Layer 4** (>4.41 m): 222.5 Ω·m

**Curve Type Evaluation:**
The on-file survey classifies Station T-20 as **A-type**. However, evaluation of consecutive three-layer segments indicates:
* Layers 1–2–3: $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$ ($64.6 < 775.4 > 110.3\text{ }\Omega\cdot\text{m}$) $\rightarrow$ **K-type**
* Layers 2–3–4: $\rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4$ ($775.4 > 110.3 < 222.5\text{ }\Omega\cdot\text{m}$) $\rightarrow$ **H-type**

The actual 4-layer sounding is a **KH-type** curve. The archived A-type classification does not fit the interpreted layer values.

{"curve_type_stated": "A", "label_issue_flagged": true}
